nodes.name: Scheduled Retry Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every few minutes and picks up DLQ items whose next_retry_at is due.

nodes.name: Load Due DLQ Items
nodes.notes: Select rows from dead_letter_queue where status is pending or retrying and next_retry_at <= now().

nodes.name: Replay Retry Handler
nodes.notes: Call a future dashboard retry endpoint with the DLQ item id so the app can apply the same retry and escalation logic used by Force Retry.

nodes.name: Resolve Or Escalate
nodes.notes: Resolved items stop here. Retryable failures schedule the next retry window. Max-retry or non-retryable failures escalate.

nodes.name: Update Queue Row
nodes.notes: Persist the resolved, pending, failed, or escalated status if the retry endpoint does not already handle the database update.
